what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Argentina in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4621 Argentine asylum seekers, and Spain hosted 40.1% of them.
After Spain, the largest hosts are the United States, Italy and Brazil.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Argentina, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 1559 asylum seekers, and the figure fell to a low in 2012.
It then rose, reaching its highest point, 6189, at the end of 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
